beats.explanation: Patrol on the way. Good call.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A very calm voice with very odd priorities.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: I need bitcoins urgently! 🪙

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: I want to buy a virtual kitten.

choices.label: You don't need bitcoins for that.
What are you gonna name it? 😏

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: George Cheddar Washington!

beats.explanation: Great choice. Now please free the line.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 2 a.m. A whisper. Something about the undead.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: I think I saw a zombie! 🧟

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: It's in front of me, eating rotten flesh!

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Atlanta, Georgia. PLEASE hurry!

beats.explanation: You actually send the Zombie Containment Unit. Atlanta can sleep again.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The caller giggles, then gasps.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: I'm seeing green elves! 🧝

choices.label: Can you catch one? I want a pet. 😏

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: It was a challenge! Now they won't leave!

choices.label: Try something less abrasive next time.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: 7 Mushroom Lane. Hurry!

beats.explanation: Experts arrive to bring the caller back to earth.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Water — or worse — pooling under a sink, and a caller who can't tell which.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: I think there's a leak! Something's dripping and it stinks.

choices.label: Does it smell sweet or like rotten eggs?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Rotten eggs, definitely. And hissing.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: It's 5 Cobble Lane, the corner unit.

beats.explanation: Gas leak, caught early. Crew seals it. No boom, just relief.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Short, sharp breaths. This one's serious.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Help, my Mother-in-law is having a Heart Attack!

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Shortness of breath. She says it hurts!

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: 3rd floor, by the chili dog stand. Hurry!

beats.explanation: Ambulance dispatched. Stay calm, she'll be okay.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: An anguished voice, echoing off bathroom tile. The camera, if there were one, would rather not come in.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: HELP! I'm out of toilet paper!

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: I don't care.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: I'm barefoot!

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Please, I pooped!

beats.explanation: Nicely handled. Good judgment pays, and the city cracks a smile.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A dim elevator car, stalled between floors, one bar of signal.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: I'm stuck in an elevator! It just stopped!

choices.label: Stay calm. Are you alone in there?
Try the trapdoor like in movies.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Yeah, alone. It's getting stuffy.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Tower B, Westgate Apartments. Between 4 and 5.

beats.explanation: Rescue pries the doors. You stayed on the line the whole way. The city notices that.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Smoke under a door, a voice low to the floor, heat you can feel through the speaker.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: I'm trapped in the fire!!! I can't get to the door!

choices.label: Stay low. Is there a window you can reach?
Have you tried not being on fire?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: There's a window — I'm by it now.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Second floor, 22 Halford Street.

beats.explanation: Ladder up, window out. They make it. You don't breathe until they do.

missions.title: My cat is stuck on a tall tree

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: An old oak, a tiny furious silhouette near the top, a worried owner below.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: My cat is stuck on a tall tree and won't come down!

choices.label: Is the cat hurt, or just stubborn?
Let it live up there. New life.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Just stubborn. And judging me, honestly.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Corner of Maple and 3rd, the big tree.

beats.explanation: Animal Control handles it — they coax the cat down, calm and quick.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A heartbroken caller. And a missing hamburger.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: My cat just disappeared! 🐱

choices.label: When did you last see him?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: At my Mom's. Also my hamburger is gone!

choices.label: We can send someone to look.
The cat ate the burger. Case closed. 😏

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Please, just help me find him! 5 Willow St.

beats.explanation: Animal control swings by. Check your Mom's first.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A groan, like the world is too loud.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: My head is about to explode! 🤯

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: HUGE migraine, man. I feel like throwing up.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Thank you for sending someone! 12 Pine Rd.

beats.explanation: Ambulance en route. Aim for the toilet, just in case.

missions.title: My House Is Full of Pests!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A low, constant buzzing hum down the line. Something is moving in the walls.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: My whole house is infested! Bugs in the walls, the vents, the cereal — everywhere! I can't even walk through the kitchen.

choices.label: Get everyone and the pets outside.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: We're all out on the lawn. There's grandma, the kids, and the dog — and a LOT of bugs following us.

choices.label: Stay out, don't reenter — sending the team.
Seal the doors so they don't spread next door.
Just light a few hundred candles 🕯️

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: 742 Birchwood Road. We'll be on the lawn — the one cloud of bugs you can't miss. Please hurry!

beats.explanation: Pest control en route to fumigate and clear the house. Keep everyone on the lawn until they call the all-clear.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Split screen: a hallway filling with smoke. The caller sounds strangely calm.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: My house is on fire.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Not really — I can't get out!

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: My closet, I think. Maybe the bedroom.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: ...What?!

choices.label: Is someone else there with you?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: 3259 Wescam Court. Please hurry!

beats.explanation: Engines roll. You stay on the line until they're out. The city breathes easier.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Split screen: you at the console; on the other end, a kitchen vanishing into orange smoke.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: My kitchen is on fire! 🔥

choices.label: Are you out of the house?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: WHAT?! This is an EMERGENCY!

choices.label: And emergencies are what we do 😎
Sorry. Are you out of the house?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: No, it's way too hot!

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: I can't get out, it's too hot!

choices.label: Get out of the house NOW.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: I need someone, please!

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: 989 Burb Street.

beats.explanation: Sirens. The truck rounds the corner before the roof gives. The city breathes a little easier. Citizen trust ticks up. Clean.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Knocking. Then pounding. Then a voice barely holding it together.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Someone's trying to force my door open!

choices.label: Stay calm. Ask who it is.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: It's 2 a.m.! It's my weird neighbor — HELP!

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Apartment 4B, Maple Court. Please hurry!

beats.explanation: Units en route. Keep the door blocked.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Splashing. A scream swallowed by water. Whoever's calling can barely get the words out.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Help! Someone's drowning — he went under and he's not coming back up!

choices.label: Can you see them right now?
Don't jump in — are YOU safe?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: He came up once! There's a life ring on the dock — should I throw it?!

choices.label: Throw the ring — don't go in after him.
Keep eyes on him. Help is coming.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: I got the ring to him! He's holding on — Eastside Lake, the public dock. PLEASE hurry!

beats.explanation: Ambulance and water rescue rolling. Get him out, check his breathing — you kept him alive.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A hushed voice, curtains barely parted. Three in the morning, and the street outside should be empty.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: There are people loading boxes into a van across the street. No lights, no talking. They've been at it for an hour.

choices.label: Stay inside. Can you describe the van?
Maybe it's just a late move?
Go knock and ask what they're doing.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: White panel van, no plates I can see. And… some of the boxes have air holes. Why would a box need air holes?

choices.label: Keep watching from cover. Help is coming.
Get the cross streets and stay on the line.
Honk your horn to scare them off.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Corner of Calder and 14th. They're closing the doors — please, send someone before they drive off!

beats.explanation: Patrol rolling, quiet approach. You kept the caller safe and gave them a van, a corner, and a reason to hurry.

missions.title: There's a fire in my bathroom!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A scented candle, a towel, and a very bad decision, now spreading.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: There's a fire in my bathroom! It's climbing the towels!

choices.label: Close the door and get out. Don't fight it.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Door's closed, I'm in the hall.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Flat 7, 19 Sienna Road.

beats.explanation: One room lost, a building saved. Clean work. Trust ticks up.

missions.title: There's a Ghost in My House!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A door creaks on the other end. Then a whisper that is definitely not the caller.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: There's a GHOST in my house! It floated through the wall and rearranged my fridge magnets!

choices.label: Okay… what did the magnets spell?
Are you and everyone safe right now?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: That's what I said! Then it turned the lights off. TWICE.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: It spelled 'BOO.' Real original. Now it's hovering by the stairs — please send someone who handles… this!

choices.label: Step outside, don't provoke it, wait for the team.
Ask if it's a friendly ghost first 👻
Who you gonna call? We've got a guy.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: I'm on the porch now. 13 Mourning Dove Lane, Hollow Pines. Hurry — it's doing the curtains thing!

beats.explanation: Ghostbusters rolling, proton packs charged. Stay on the porch — they've got the BOO under control.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Skittering. A lot of skittering. And then a scream that goes up an entire octave.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: There's a cockroach in my kitchen and it's the SIZE OF A DOG. It just opened my fridge!

choices.label: Get out of the room and shut the door.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: I'm in the hallway! It hissed at me and took my sandwich. Please send the bug people!

choices.label: Don't corner it — wait outside for the team.
Hit it with a shoe the size of a canoe.
Pest control's on it. Stay clear.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Sunny Acres, unit 3C. It's wearing my oven mitt now. WHY is it wearing my oven mitt?!

beats.explanation: Pest control rolling — traps, suits, the big vacuum. Stay in the hall. You can keep the sandwich; it can keep the mitt.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Radio static, breaking glass, a siren drowned out by the roar of a crowd. An officer's voice cuts through, breathing hard.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Dispatch, this is Unit 12 — riot's gone out of control downtown. I need backup, NOW!

choices.label: Have you tried asking them nicely?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Crowd's over a hundred and they've taken the intersection. I'm not injured — I can't hold this alone!

choices.label: Hold your position, backup is inbound.
Fall back to a safe perimeter and wait.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Copy. Holding at 5th and Main — send everything you've got, fast!

beats.explanation: Backup units rolling to 5th and Main. Hang on, Unit 12 — they're almost there.
